notes: Post dated November 12, 2025: rolling out in ChatGPT that day. API on 2025-11-13 (openai.com/index/gpt-5-1-for-developers/, and the API changelog for Nov 13). Price: 'same as GPT-5', which is $1.25 in / $10 out on the model page.

Released in the API on 2025-11-13 alongside GPT-5.1 (changelog Nov 13). No dated snapshot. Now shut down per the model page.
Released in the API on 2025-11-13 (changelog). Price $0.25/$2 on the model page, also in its 2026-02-13 archive.

The GPT-5.1 post says 'We will also update GPT-5 Pro to GPT-5.1 Pro soon'. No release date was confirmed from a primary source, and there was never a gpt-5.1-pro API model (none in the models index or the changelog).
Post dated December 11, 2025: 'In the API, they are available now'. Changelog also Dec 11. OpenRouter lists 2025-12-10, a timezone artifact; its slug carries 20251211. Price stated in the post.
Released 2025-12-11 with GPT-5.2. The alias was repointed on 2026-02-10 (changelog). Now deprecated.
Responses API only. Price $21/$168 stated in the post's price table. Highest-compute variant of 5.2.

Post dated December 18, 2025: in Codex for paid ChatGPT users, API 'in the coming weeks'. Reached the API on 2026-01-14 (changelog Jan 14), which matches OpenRouter. Price $1.75/$14, from the 2026-02-13 archive of the model page.

Post dated February 5, 2026: in Codex for paid ChatGPT plans, API 'soon'. Reached the API on 2026-02-24 (changelog Feb 24), which matches OpenRouter. Price $1.75/$14, from the 2026-02-26 archive of the model page. OpenAI never released a general GPT-5.3 Thinking or API gpt-5.3, so this is the most capable 5.3 model and the one to benchmark for the generation.
Research preview for ChatGPT Pro users in Codex. In the API only for 'a small set of design partners'. Not a general release and no public price. Low-latency real-time coding model.

Post dated March 3, 2026: for all ChatGPT users and in the API as gpt-5.3-chat-latest that day (changelog Mar 3). Price $1.75/$14 from the current model page; not checked against a launch-time capture. Not in the OpenRouter snapshot. The post's 'Updates to Thinking and Pro will follow soon' never became a 5.3 Thinking; GPT-5.4 came instead.
Post dated March 5, 2026: ChatGPT, Codex and API (gpt-5.4) the same day; changelog Mar 5. Price stated in the post's table; prompts over 272K tokens cost $5/$22.50. 1.05M context.
Responses API, 2026-03-05. Price $30/$180, from the 2026-03-06 archive of the pricing page.
Post dated March 17, 2026: API, Codex and ChatGPT that day; price stated in the post.
API only, 2026-03-17; price stated in the post.

Post dated April 23, 2026: ChatGPT and Codex that day, API 'very soon'. Reached the API on 2026-04-24 (changelog Apr 24), which matches OpenRouter. The snapshot id carries 04-23. Price stated in the post. 1M context.
In ChatGPT (Pro, Business, Enterprise) on 2026-04-23. API on 2026-04-24 (changelog). Price stated in the post.

Post dated May 5, 2026: the ChatGPT default model, and in the API as chat-latest (changelog May 5). chat-latest is a moving alias: it was repointed on 2026-05-28, 06-24, 08-06 and 10-07 (changelog). Price $5/$30, from the 2026-05-06 archive of the model page.

Post dated July 9, 2026: generally available across ChatGPT, Codex and the API that day; changelog Jul 9. Before that, a limited preview for trusted partners only began on 2026-06-26 (openai.com/index/previewing-gpt-5-6-sol/). Launch price is stated in both posts. Sol was cut to $4/$20 on 2026-08-21 as promotional pricing 'at least through November 21, 2026' (changelog), which is the price OpenRouter shows. An improved Sol went into ChatGPT on 2026-08-06. OpenRouter's dated slug is its own; OpenAI publishes no dated 5.6 snapshot.

Not a separate model. From 5.6 onward Pro is a Responses API mode on the same slug ('do not switch to a separate Pro model slug'), billed at the base model's token rates with more tokens used (latest-model guide). It launched with the family (changelog Jul 9). Price changes follow the base model.

The mid tier ('roughly corresponds to the mini model tier'), released 2026-07-09. Price cut 20% to $2/$12 from 2026-07-30 (changelog; openai.com/index/advancing-the-price-performance-frontier-with-gpt-5-6/). Launch price confirmed in the post and in the 2026-07-13 archive of the model page.
Pro mode of the same model, billed at Terra's rates (see the Sol pro mode row).

The low tier ('roughly corresponds to the nano model tier'), released 2026-07-09. Price cut 80% to $0.20/$1.20 from 2026-07-30 (changelog). Launch price confirmed in the post and in the 2026-07-13 archive of the model page.
Pro mode of the same model, billed at Luna's rates (see the Sol pro mode row).

Post dated 2026-09-03 (OpenAI news feed): 'rolling out today to a limited set of organizations and over the coming days' to ChatGPT paid plans, the API and AWS. The changelog says 'Released GPT-6 Astra' on Sep 3. OpenRouter lists 09-04, with slug 20260903. Prompts over 272K tokens cost 2x input and 1.5x output. OpenAI's most capable model; the first to reach Critical cyber capability under its Preparedness Framework (Safety overview, 2026-09-03).

ChatGPT Pro, Business and Enterprise get 'GPT-6 Astra Pro' at launch (Astra post). In the API, the GPT-6 guide says GPT-6 supports pro mode, billed at Astra's rates. No changelog entry dates API pro mode for Astra specifically.

Post dated 2026-09-22 (news feed). API gpt-6-sol and ChatGPT Work and Codex that day; changelog Sep 22 gives $2/$10. The post compares it with GPT-5.6 Sol: '$4 -> $2' input and '$20 -> $10' output. Superseded by GPT-6.1 Sol.
Pro mode of the same model, billed at Sol's rates (the GPT-6 guide says GPT-6 supports pro mode).
Post dated 2026-09-22. Changelog Sep 22 gives $0.10/$0.50. The Decisions API launched on it: beta 2026-10-06, GA 2026-10-22.
Pro mode of the same model, billed at Luna's rates.

Post dated October 7, 2026: GPT-6 rolling out in the ChatGPT Chat tab, to paid tiers that day and Free and Go the next. The changelog repointed chat-latest the same day. No new price was stated; the chat-latest page showed $5/$30 on 2026-10-25. The post does not say which GPT-6 tier it is.

Released 2026-09-29 at DevDay (news feed and changelog). 'Near-Astra' at one fifth of Astra's price. Standard API price $2/$10, cached input $0.10. This is the only 6.1 model and the newest at the time of writing. OpenAI still ranks GPT-6 Astra above it, so for a frontier series Astra stays the top OpenAI model.
Pro mode of the same model, billed at 6.1 Sol's rates. The GPT-6 guide says the GPT-6 family supports pro mode; no source names 6.1 Sol pro mode specifically.
